text: {"headline": "Records show overtime cut from 48 to 30 hours for one weekend team; who made the change and why remain disputed and unconfirmed", "overview": "This brief summarizes calibrated claims from a review packet about 48 overtime hours submitted on 4 March 2026 and later reduced. Documents (emails, a ledger, and review-status and audit notes) show the amounts and some process steps. Reporter statements are attributed to the reporter and have no document support in this set. Accounts conflict on whether the removed hours were duplicate entries or legitimate scheduled shifts. Most dates are unresolved, and several participants are redacted or shown as placeholders.", "key_points": ["Nima Brack submitted 48 overtime hours for the weekend dispatch team on 4 March 2026. [C005]", "The packet gives an agreed overtime rate of $24 per hour. At that rate, the original 48 hours total $1,152 and the edited 30 hours total $720, a $432 difference. The records state these figures, and the arithmetic matches the stated rate. [C006, C007]", "The overtime was recorded as edited to 30 hours. This claim has moderate confidence because extraction samples agreed only partly. [C008]", "The ledger lists L001 as paid overtime of 30 hours ($720.00), L002 as repaid overtime of 6 hours ($144.00), and L003 as disputed overtime of 12 hours ($288.00), with a packet total of $1,152.00. All entries are dated 2026-04-10. [C030, C036, C037, C038]", "Six hours were restored for $144, and 12 hours ($288) remain in dispute. A review status document says PERSON_1 authorized repayment of six removed hours in early April. Partial verification means the document's identity is not confirmed. [C009, C010, C018]", "Early messages in the packet show Nima Brack challenging the missing overtime in the payroll queue. [C001]", "A redacted participant said they had the earlier copy and that the totals did not match yet. Nima Brack asked that the original and edit history be kept, and the redacted participant agreed to keep the original. These message dates are unresolved. [C002, C003, C033]", "PERSON_1 said the matter should be kept in the review queue. [C004]", "An email dated 4 March 2026 from a redacted sender to PERSON_1 had the subject about clock corrections for pay period 06. A later email dated 6 March 2026 in the same thread from Nima Brack says a working register was attached. [C016, C029, C014]", "The correction reason is recorded only as 'budget alignment,' and employee approvals are blank. [C012]", "Nima Brack's email alleges that PERSON_1 removed 18 overtime hours from approved timesheets without employee sign-off, 'two days later.' This allegation is uncorroborated. The passage does not tie the timing to the 4 March submission. [C015]", "A payroll memo from PERSON_1 says all 18 removed hours were duplicate clock entries. This conflicts with the allegation about those hours. [C023, C015]", "The reporter says the shifts were scheduled loading shifts, not accidental double punches, while noting they cannot speak for every break. This account is uncorroborated by the documents here. [C028, C031]", "Gate scans and loading manifests cover all three shifts, but the record notes that a gate scan does not itself establish paid working time. [C011]", "The packet does not confirm who authorized the disputed change. [C020]", "The audit date is not on the calendar extract. No signed audit report was available for the packet, and the signed report and an independent copy of the source register are still requested. [C019, C024, C022]", "After the audit, Nima Brack exported the timesheet revision history. A receipt dated 10 April 2026 records a preservation action. [C021, C032]", "Reporter statements, uncorroborated by documents here: they reconcile dispatch hours before the pay file closes, watched the total drop after approval, kept both exports, and were asked by unnamed people why payslips were short. [C025, C026, C027, C039]", "Nima Brack's signature block gives the role of review coordinator. [C017]", "A statement in the packet says no conclusions should be reached until the source records are checked. The speaker is not identified. [C034]"], "risk_notes": ["The 18 removed hours have conflicting accounts: an allegation of removal without sign-off versus a memo saying they were duplicate entries, plus a reporter account of legitimate scheduled shifts. These accounts have not been reconciled. [C015, C023, C028]", "The allegation about the 18 hours is only partly verified, and its timing relative to the 4 March submission is not established. Treat the sequence as provisional. [C015, C005]", "The review status document's attribution (C018) and the authorship of the email (C035) are only partly supported, so these points should be treated as provisional. [C018, C035]", "Most dates are unresolved, and several participants are redacted or shown as placeholders, so the packet cannot reliably attribute each statement to a specific person. [C001, C002, C033]", "Ledger totals reconcile arithmetically to the stated rate, but that does not show the underlying hours were correct. [C006, C038]", "The reporter's account has no document support in this packet and should not be treated as independently established. [C025, C026, C039]"], "limitations": ["The packet does not show who made the change from 48 to 30 hours, or who authorized it; the authorizer is unconfirmed. [C020, C008]", "The packet does not establish whether the 18 removed hours were duplicates, valid overtime, or removed without employee sign-off. Accounts conflict and no independent proof is given. [C015, C023]", "No signed audit report, audit date, or independent copy of the source register is in this packet, so the audit outcome cannot be verified. [C024, C019, C022]", "Gate scans and loading manifests do not by themselves establish paid working time. [C011]", "The absence of evidence here is not evidence of absence: for example, blank approvals in one record (C012) do not show that approvals exist nowhere else. [C012]", "Redactions and placeholders prevent identifying several speakers or senders, and this brief does not attempt to do so. [C013, C029]", "This brief uses calibrated claims only. It does not reach legal conclusions, guilt, or recommended actions, and it reflects only what the cited claims state. [C034]"]}
